column2: All set?
Then put {s} in the trailer with us. We're heading for the Saotome Lab!
Talk to me when you're ready.
I see. Dr. Saotome, actually...
A brain abnormally large for so small a body. We'd best assume the Reptilians can outdo humans.\n\nDo you understand now how terrifying our enemy is?
I can't let anyone into Science City without a permit! Go home!
Hayato! Musashi!
Doctor! What about Ryo!?
Is he dead!?
He's still missing. {p}-kun, come with me.
Knowing Ryo, he won't croak that easily.
Till Ryo gets back, the great Musashi's gonna give it all he's got!
{s} is in the medical team's hands. Wait for the results. More importantly, there's something I want to ask you. About the black moon.
All I know is what I told you earlier.
Hmm... The truth is, the dimensional linking phenomenon has been confirmed all over the world.
What!?\n\nThen you know other worlds exist besides this one...?
We know. In theory, at least. But now it has become reality!
Is the black moon the cause after all?
I don't know. But at this rate, something grave could happen! So I want to put your experiences to use in finding the cause!
I'd be glad to help!
Good! I'm counting on you!
{s} is in the medical team's hands. Wait for the results.
One day, out of nowhere, strangers appear in a strange place. What happened to the people who were there before? No one knows.
Right now there's a conference on the Dimension Chain in Science City. The doctor should've been invited too...
A miraculous light that makes enormous energy from a mere trace! Those are Getter Rays! Dr. Saotome is the one who discovered them.
Creatures other than humans are after the surface of this Earth. Dr. Saotome realized that and built this lab.
Three Getter Machines combine into Getter Robo! And Getter Robo can change into three different forms! Being able to fight in the form that suits the situation, that's Getter Robo's strength.
The Eagle's pretty badly damaged, but we're repairing it at full speed. But if a Mechasaurus attacked us now... we'd be in trouble!
Ryooo! W-without you, there ain't no Getter Team!!
Don't cry, Musashi. Nobody's said he's dead yet.
I hope you find Ryo-san...
Can you tell what these bones are from? A giant lizard's head, a pteranodon's arms and wings, and a human's body! A life form that took a different evolutionary path from us. That's a Reptilian!
About {s}'s illness, we can't find the cause with the equipment here...
No... Doctor! What should I do?
She needs a more advanced medical facility. If you went to Science City, perhaps...
Science City...\n\nLet's talk to Dr. Saotome.
I just got the report myself. You want to go to Science City?
Yes!
I'll contact them so you can get into Science City. Go right away.
Thank you, Doctor!
About {s}'s illness, we can't find the cause with the equipment here... She needs a more advanced medical facility. If you went to Science City, perhaps...
Feeling unwell? Your color looks good, though.
I wanted to attend the conference in Science City too, but with Ryo missing, I can't leave the lab.
I understand. Thank you, Doctor!
When you see the enemy, don't think, just strike them down! Be utterly ruthless! That's what it takes to survive.
Yes, sir...
That Musashi's still hugging Ryo's helmet and bawling.
Musashi-san's a kind person.
He's just soft.
I'd like you to... hand Dr. Saotome over to me.
Dunno who you are, but get lost.\n\nOr you'll get hurt worse than a few bandages can fix.
Acting all cool is what makes you soft!
That stance, those moves...!?\n\nStop it, Ryo!
Ryo!?
Ryo...?
You can't fool my eyes. You're Ryo, without a doubt.
Ugh... Ryo?
Surely you haven't forgotten me?\n\nWhy are you doing this, Ryo?
Ryo... I don't know! I'm just...!
Ah, wait! Ryo!!
Hayato-san, are you okay!?
...That wasn't Ryo! His eyes were a wild animal's. The eyes of a beast with no reason left. No way that was Ryo!
The medicine bag he dropped.\n\nIt has the name of a research facility in Science City on it... It seems I'll have to go to Science City myself.
Dr. Saotome!
We'll head to Science City in the Bear. {s} too. There's no time to lose. We leave at once.
{p}, take care of Dr. Saotome for us!
Please go on through. Dr. Saotome is waiting.
There's a conference going on in the Grand Conference Hall to the north right now. Dr. Saotome should be there too.
The Eagle's pilot is missing? What'll they do if a Mechasaurus attacks?
I've had {s} admitted to the hospital here in Science City. Go visit her while you look around the city. I'll be showing my face at the conference, so come by later.
There's a big hotel in the southeast of Science City. It's so huge that first-timers usually get lost inside.
I acknowledge your theory!\n\nBut what you are trying to do is wrong!
Is Dr. Saotome really here?
{p}, over here!
Dr. Saotome! Uh-oh, can I get over there...?
If words won't make you understand, I'll beat the lesson into you!
Third-rate scientists like you are of no use alive! Learn it the hard way! Hahahaha...!
Oh no! We've got to save Dr. Saotome!
Rescuing Professor Yumi comes first right now!
Rescuing Dr. Saotome comes first right now!
Thank you! Thank you for saving me!
Doctor! Are you all right!?
Yes, I'm fine!
...Where is Genzo Kuruma?
The doctor went that way...
He's gone...
Who could that man be...
We've learned where the bandaged man who seems to be Ryo is. Someone saw a man like that near the Science City hotel. {p}, will you come with me?
Got it!
Ugh... Ryo... This name won't get out of my head! What is it!? What on earth is "Ryo"!?
It seems Ryo underwent some sort of human experiment. He's lost his true memories!
How could they do something so horrible...!
How can mankind be wiped out easily? The Reptilians have been performing human experiments again and again to find out.
Unforgivable!
You wretches! When did you get here!?
This face...! It IS Ryo!
Ryo... Ryo...
Isn't there a way to cure amnesia?
A strong shock can sometimes bring memories back... but otherwise, only time will heal it...
